Name: UCE -- Unnecessary Content Extension
Author: Tomoe1121
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=6][b]UCE -- Unnecessary Content Extension[/b][/size]
[quote]Nobody asked for this. I wanted it anyway.[/quote]UCE -- Unnecessary Content Extension is a Stardew Valley mod that adds a crop mutation to the game.

It started as a personal project because i wanted Stardew Valley to have more things happening to my crops. What begin as a simple mutation idea gradually turned into a larger system involving crop behavior , harvests, artisan goods, and eventually plans for much more!!.

This is [b]Version 0.1,[/b] so this is only the beginning.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Download UCE[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]TomoeCropMutations[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]🌱 Crop Mutations
Crops can acquire different mutations under different conditions.

Mutations can :[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Increase the value of crops[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Affect how crops behave[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Be applied through environmental conditions[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Be caused by nearby objects[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Interact with other mutations[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Carry over to harvested items[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Affect artisan goods made from mutated crops[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Multiple mutations can exist on the same crop.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] — obviously needed.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url] — recommended if you want to see mutations more easily. [/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
This mod was also inspired by the mutation mechanic from the Roblox game [b]Grow A Garden[/b].
I wanted to play something where I could focus on the mutation system while having much more content built around it, so I decided to make my own version for Stardew Valley.

Thanks to [b]Grow A Garden[/b] for existing and giving me the idea!!

And thanks to everyone who decides to try UCE. ❤️
